policija_kd.publisher: Republika Slovenija, Ministrstvo za notranje zadeve in javno upravo, Policija
policija_kd.file_urls: https://www.policija.si/baza/kd2001.zip through https://www.policija.si/baza/kd2024.zip (one zip per year; 2001-2007 contain KDINTKD.txt + šifranti.txt, 2008 DOGODKI.TXT + SIFRANTI.TXT, 2009-2024 kdYYYY.csv)
policija_kd.notes: Record-level files of every criminal offence for which the police filed a criminal complaint or report, with the year of the concluding document (LetoZakljucnegaDokumenta) as the file year. Each file has one row per person involved, so offences were de-duplicated on ZaporednaStevilkaKD. Rows selected by OpisKD text: 'UMOR' (murder, KZ-1 art. 116 / KZ art. 127), 'UBOJ' (manslaughter, KZ-1 art. 115), 'UBOJ NA MAH' (art. 117 / KZ art. 128), 'DETOMOR' (infanticide, KZ art. 130, pre-2008 code only), 'POVZROČITEV SMRTI IZ MALOMARNOSTI' (negligent homicide, art. 118 / KZ art. 129). Attempts are flagged by the Poskus field (DA/D) and given as Completed, Attempted, and Completed + attempted. Areas: PU storitve (police directorate where committed: PU Celje, Koper, Kranj, Ljubljana, Maribor, Murska Sobota, Nova Gorica, Novo Mesto; plus the former PU Krško, PU Postojna, PU Slovenj Gradec until 2010-2011, and GPU/MNZ/NI PODATKA/code 000 for offences not assigned to a directorate) and Upravna enota (administrative unit, 58 units, with the police directorate as parent). Pre-2009 files give codes that were decoded with the šifranti.txt code list shipped in each zip. Extracted with python csv module; script at /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/98c1a0c8-be55-5a6a-907a-bd7768dfbf58/scratchpad/svn_extract.py (copy in problems.md).

problems:
# Slovenia (SVN) - sub-national homicide

## What was found
The Slovenian Police publish full record-level crime files (every criminal offence with a police complaint/report) for each year 2001-2024 at https://www.policija.si/o-slovenski-policiji/statistika/kriminaliteta ("Statistični podatki v csv obliki", files /baza/kdYYYY.zip). Fields include the police directorate (PU) where the offence was committed, the administrative unit (upravna enota), the offence article/description, and whether it was an attempt. From these, rows.csv aggregates homicide offences by police directorate and by administrative unit (parent = PU), plus a country total, for every year 2001-2024.

## Caveats
- The year is the year of the police concluding document, not the year of the act (the instructions page says this). A 2024 file contains some acts from earlier years.
- The counts are offences (one ZaporednaStevilkaKD per offence), not victims. A double murder may be one offence.
- "Completed" = Poskus field NE/N; "Attempted" = DA/D. Both are given, plus the sum. The police's own annual reports count umor+uboj including attempts.
- Pre-2008 Criminal Code (KZ, 1995) had "umor" (art. 127) covering what KZ-1 (2008) splits into "uboj" (art. 115) and "umor" (art. 116). So the 2001-2008 "Umor" category corresponds to the later Umor+Uboj. The summary line "Intentional homicide (umor + uboj + uboj na mah + detomor)" is my sum across those labels, so it is comparable across the code change. Negligent homicide (art. 118/129) is given separately and not included in it.
- Police directorates were reorganised: PU Krško, PU Postojna and PU Slovenj Gradec existed until 2011 (merged into Novo Mesto/Koper/Celje). Codes "GPU", "MNZ (ZA STATISTIKO R SLOVENIJA)", "NI PODATKA" and "PU code 000" are offences not attributed to a directorate; they are kept as published.
- Only areas with at least one matching offence in a year have a row (zero rows are not generated).
- Encoding of the source files is cp1250; a few 2006-2007 labels have mojibake in the source (e.g. "POVZRO¬ITEV") - matching used the stem "SMRTI" + "MALOMARNO" so those are still captured.
- No licence statement was found on the statistics pages (checked the kriminaliteta page, the navodila page and the statistika page; none mention a licence or Creative Commons).

## Not used / other sources
- SURS SiStat (pxweb.stat.si) justice tables (searched the data service with "kazniva", "umor", "regij kazniva dejanja") are for Slovenia as a whole (convicted persons, prosecutions) with no regional dimension.
- policija.si annual reports "Poročilo o delu policije za leto YYYY" (2010-2025, PDF/Word) also contain tables of umor/uboj by police directorate; not extracted because the CSV micro-data covers the same and more. policija.si was intermittently timing out (connection resets) during this session.
